title.zh: 后来的怀唐伊签署记述

alt.en: A worn blue pamphlet cover names William Colenso and the signing of the Treaty of Waitangi.
alt.zh: 磨损的蓝色册封标有威廉·科伦索姓名与怀唐伊条约签署主题。

caption.en: William Colenso’s account was published in Wellington in 1890, fifty years after the signing. This is its printed cover, not an 1840 treaty sheet.
caption.zh: 威廉·科伦索的记述于1890年在惠灵顿出版，距签署已五十年。这是书册封面，并非1840年的条约原件。

interpretation.en: The cover promises English and Māori treaty texts. Its claim to an authoritative history invites comparison with the differing texts and the perspectives of Māori signatories.
interpretation.zh: 封面说明书中收录英文和毛利文条约。其权威历史的自我定位，应与文本差异及毛利签署者的视角对读。

title.zh: 宪法颁布后的图普一世

alt.en: An elderly king stands with a walking stick beside a chair on mats in front of a veranda.
alt.zh: 年长的国王拄杖站在铺席上，身旁有椅子，身后是门廊。

caption.en: Alfred Burton photographed George Tupou I on 26 July 1884. The portrait postdates the king’s 1875 constitution; it does not show its proclamation.
caption.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·伯顿于1884年7月26日拍摄乔治·图普一世。肖像晚于国王1875年颁布宪法，并非颁宪现场。

interpretation.en: The cane, chair and formal coat stage royal presence in a domestic setting. The constitution reshaped institutions while retaining the king’s central authority.
interpretation.zh: 手杖、椅子与正式外衣，在居住环境中呈现王者身份。宪法改造制度的同时，保留了国王的核心权威。

title.en: A naval camp in the Waikato campaign
title.zh: 怀卡托战役中的海军营地

alt.en: Pale tents cluster beside tracks and a waterway beneath open hills.
alt.zh: 浅色帐篷聚集于小路与水道旁，后方是开阔丘陵。

caption.en: Daniel Beere’s 1864 photograph records the naval camp at Mangatāwhiri Creek. Te Papa places it in his series documenting sites of the Waikato campaign.
caption.zh: 丹尼尔·比尔1864年的照片记录了曼加塔菲里溪海军营地。蒂帕帕将其置于记录怀卡托战役地点的系列中。

interpretation.en: Tents and tracks make military occupation visible. The distant view does not show Māori experiences of the invasion or establish that the surrounding land was empty.
interpretation.zh: 帐篷与道路使军事占领可见。远景没有呈现毛利人的被侵略经历，也不能证明周围土地原本无人居住。

title.zh: 针对马乌运动的殖民传单

alt.en: A royal coat of arms heads a Samoan-language leaflet with three numbered claims and a governor’s name.
alt.zh: 萨摩亚文传单上方有王室纹章，下方列三项说法并署总督姓名。

caption.en: The New Zealand government issued this leaflet in Samoa on 10 February 1930. It used Nelson’s abandoned libel case to discredit the Mau movement.
caption.zh: 新西兰政府于1930年2月10日在萨摩亚发布此传单，借尼尔森撤回诽谤诉讼一事贬损马乌运动。

interpretation.en: The official crest and numbered assertions turn print into an instrument of colonial authority. These are the administration’s accusations, not an impartial account of the movement.
interpretation.zh: 官方纹章与编号论断，使印刷品成为殖民权力工具。这些是当局的指责，而非对运动的中立叙述。

alt.en: Openwork crosses sit within a circular band edged with small triangular loops above a hollow shaft.
alt.zh: 镂空十字置于圆环内，边缘饰小三角环，下接空心柄。

caption.en: This Ethiopian copper-alloy processional cross dates to the fourteenth–fifteenth century. Its hollow shaft fitted a pole used to carry it aloft.
caption.zh: 这件埃塞俄比亚铜合金巡游十字架作于十四至十五世纪。空心柄可套在长杆上，以便高举行进。

interpretation.en: Casting and openwork gave public worship a material form during the Early Solomonic period. The catalogue does not identify a royal patron or a specific original church.
interpretation.zh: 铸造与镂空技艺，使早期所罗门时期的公共礼拜具有物质形式。目录未确定王室委托者或最初所属教堂。

title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚抄本中的大卫

alt.en: A bearded figure in red and yellow robes holds a stringed instrument on a worn parchment leaf.
alt.zh: 磨损的羊皮纸页上，蓄须人物穿红黄衣袍，手持弦乐器。

caption.en: This fifteenth-century Ethiopian manuscript leaf represents King David with a stringed instrument. The museum relates it to the Psalms and notes calligraphy practice on its reverse.
caption.zh: 这页十五世纪埃塞俄比亚抄本描绘持弦乐器的大卫王。博物馆将其与《诗篇》联系，并指出背面有书法练习。

interpretation.en: The colored robes and carefully drawn strings reveal the labor of manuscript painting. This is medieval biblical imagery, not a portrait of a Solomonic Ethiopian ruler; its original monastery is not identified.
interpretation.zh: 彩色衣袍与细描琴弦体现抄本绘制劳动。这是中世纪圣经图像，并非埃塞俄比亚所罗门王朝君主的肖像；原属修道院未定。
